sections.title: The reverse direction
sections.content: -ról/-ről is the delative suffix — motion off a surface, the mirror image of -ra/-re. It pairs naturally with levesz ("to take down, to take off"): leveszem means "I take it down/off".

items.english: I take the book off the shelf.
I take the bag off the table.

sections.content: -ról/-ről mirrors -ra/-re exactly — the same noun, the same back/front choice, just describing motion in the opposite direction: a polcra teszem vs. leveszem a polcról.
